client.downloadFailed: The download failed. Nothing was saved.
client.fileExpired: This download has expired. Choose the quality again to prepare it once more.
client.fileGone: The file isn't available any more. Choose the quality again.
client.jobExpired: The file expired. Choose the quality again.
client.pollTimeout: The download took too long and was stopped.
client.rate_limited: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
client.server_error: The download service had a problem. Nothing was downloaded.
client.timeout: The download service took too long to respond. Try again in a moment.
client.unknown: Something went wrong. Nothing was downloaded.
code.age_restricted: This content is age-restricted and requires logging in, so it can't be downloaded.
code.busy: The downloader is busy right now. Please try again in a minute.
code.drm_protected: This content is DRM-protected and can't be downloaded.
code.expired: This download has expired. Please start it again.
code.extractor_failed: We couldn't read this post. The platform may have changed something on its side.
code.geo_blocked: This content isn't available in the server's region.
code.invalid_format: That format isn't available for this content.
code.invalid_response: The download service sent an unexpected response. Nothing was downloaded.
code.live_stream: Live streams can't be downloaded. Try again after the stream has ended.
code.login_required: This content requires logging in, so it can't be downloaded.
code.network: Couldn't reach the download service. Check your connection and try again.
code.network_error: We couldn't reach the platform. Please try again later.
code.no_media: No downloadable media was found in this post.
code.not_configured: The downloader service is not connected yet.
code.platform_blocked: The platform is temporarily refusing requests from our server. Please try again later.
code.private: This content is private, so it can't be downloaded.
code.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please wait a minute and try again.
code.server_error: Something went wrong on our side. Nothing was downloaded.
code.timeout: This took too long and was stopped. Please try again.
code.too_large: This file is larger than the download limit.
code.too_long: This video is longer than the download limit.
code.unavailable: This content is unavailable. It may have been deleted or the link may be wrong.
code.unsafe_url: This link points to an address that can't be used.
code.unsupported_content: This kind of link isn't supported.
code.unsupported_url: This link isn't from a supported platform.
platform.facebook.extractor_failed: Facebook didn't give us this video. It may be private, removed, only visible to logged-in users, or limited to some regions.
platform.facebook.login_required: Facebook only shows this video to logged-in users, so it can't be downloaded.
platform.instagram.login_required: Instagram only shows this post to logged-in users (or it is from a private account), so it can't be downloaded.
platform.instagram.platform_blocked: Instagram is rate-limiting our server right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
platform.reddit.login_required: Reddit is refusing anonymous requests from our server right now, so Reddit downloads aren't working. We don't use accounts.
platform.reddit.platform_blocked: Reddit is refusing requests from our server right now. Please try again later.
platform.tiktok.geo_blocked: TikTok doesn't make this post available in our server's region.
platform.vimeo.drm_protected: Vimeo serves this video as a DRM-protected stream, so it can't be downloaded.
platform.vimeo.login_required: Vimeo now only serves videos to signed-in users or as DRM-protected streams, so Vimeo downloads don't work from our server. We don't use accounts.
platform.x.login_required: X only shows this post to logged-in users (it may be marked sensitive or protected), so it can't be downloaded.
platform.youtube.login_required: YouTube requires signing in for this video, so it can't be downloaded.
platform.youtube.platform_blocked: YouTube is asking our server to sign in to prove it isn't a bot, so YouTube downloads are blocked from our server right now. We don't use accounts or cookies. Other platforms are not affected.
